in_hebrew.name: ירולד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Jerrold comes from the Hebrew language. It is believed to mean 'God's hill.' The name is made up of two parts: 'Yeru' meaning 'hill' and 'Rod' meaning 'God.' Thus, Jerrold can be interpreted as 'God's hill' or 'God's watch.'
